title: Berry Protein Quark
instructions: Stir the quark with a splash of still or sparkling water until creamy.
Let the berries thaw briefly and fold them in together with the chia seeds.
Sweeten to taste and serve fresh.

title: Chicken and Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice in lightly salted water.
Cut the broccoli into small florets and steam for 6–8 minutes.
Dice the chicken breast, sear it in olive oil over high heat and deglaze with soy sauce.
Arrange everything together in a bowl.

title: Salmon with Colourful Roast Vegetables
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional).
Cut the vegetables into bite-sized pieces, spread them on the baking tray and drizzle with olive oil.
Season the salmon fillet with pepper, sea salt and lemon and place it next to the vegetables.
Bake for 18–20 minutes until the salmon is cooked through and juicy.

title: Apple Rings with Peanut Butter
instructions: Core the apple and cut it into slices about 1 cm thick.
Spread evenly with peanut butter.
Sprinkle with a little cinnamon.

title: Creamy Protein Porridge
instructions: Briefly bring the oats to the boil with the water/milk in a pan, stirring.
Take the pan off the heat and let it cool for 2 minutes.
Whisk in the protein powder until creamy.
Spoon into a bowl and top with blueberries.

title: Minced Beef with Sweet Potato
instructions: Peel the sweet potato, cut it into small cubes and cook in a covered pan for about 10 minutes until soft.
Add the mince and brown it over high heat.
Add the spinach and let it wilt.
Season with paprika, salt and pepper.

title: Tuna Quinoa Salad
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under hot water and cook in twice the amount of water for about 12 minutes, then let it cool.
Dice the cucumber and halve the cherry tomatoes.
Drain the tuna and flake it with a fork.
Toss everything with olive oil and lemon juice and season with salt and pepper.

title: Scrambled Egg Toast with Avocado
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and season with salt and pepper.
Cook in a non-stick pan over medium heat, stirring, until just set.
Toast the wholegrain bread and slice the avocado.
Arrange the scrambled eggs on the bread and top with avocado.

title: Red Lentil Curry
instructions: Finely dice the onion and toast it briefly with the curry powder in a pot.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 200 ml water and simmer for about 12 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and spinach and let it steep for 2–3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Skyr with Banana and Almonds
instructions: Spoon the skyr into a bowl.
Slice the banana and arrange it on top.
Roughly chop the almonds and scatter them over.

title: Overnight Oats with Strawberries
instructions: Stir the oats, skyr, milk and chia seeds together in a jar.
Leave to soak overnight in the fridge.
Cut the strawberries into pieces and add them on top before serving.

title: Spinach and Feta Omelette
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and season with salt and pepper.
Wilt the spinach in olive oil in a pan.
Pour the egg mixture over it and let it set over medium heat.
Crumble the feta over the top, fold the omelette and serve.

title: Yoghurt with Mango and Walnuts
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Dice the mango and add it on top.
Roughly chop the walnuts, scatter them over and drizzle with honey.

title: Wholegrain Wrap with Scrambled Egg and Pepper
instructions: Cut the pepper into thin strips and fry in rapeseed oil for 3 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites, add them to the pan and stir until set.
Warm the wrap briefly in the pan, fill with the scrambled egg and roll up.

title: Protein Pancakes with Blueberries
instructions: Blend the oats, banana, egg and protein powder with a stick blender into a smooth batter.
Heat a little rapeseed oil in a non-stick pan.
Cook small portions of batter for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve with blueberries.

title: Avocado and Cottage Cheese Toast
instructions: Toast the bread slices if you like.
Spread the cottage cheese on top.
Slice the avocado and tomato, lay them on top and season with pepper and salt.

title: Vegan Chia Pudding with Berries
instructions: Stir the chia seeds into the soy milk and stir again after 5 minutes.
Leave to soak in the fridge for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Top with berries and chopped almonds.

title: Tofu Scramble with Wholegrain Bread
instructions: Finely dice the onion and pepper and fry in rapeseed oil for 3 minutes.
Crumble the tofu with a fork, add it to the pan and fry for 4 minutes.
Season with turmeric, salt and pepper.
Serve with the wholegrain bread.

title: Chickpea Bowl with Hummus
instructions: Soak the bulgur in salted water according to the packet instructions.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and pepper.
Arrange everything with the chickpeas in a bowl and top with a dollop of hummus.

title: Turkey Wrap with Quark Dip
instructions: Stir the quark with salt, pepper and a little lemon juice to make a dip.
Spread it over the wrap.
Arrange the turkey breast, cucumber, tomato and lettuce on top and roll up tightly.
Cut in half and serve.

title: Wholewheat Pasta with Prawns and Courgette
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Slice the courgette and fry it with the garlic in olive oil.
Add the prawns and fry for 3 minutes.
Add the passata, simmer briefly and toss in the pasta.

title: Chicken Salad with Avocado
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper and fry in a pan for 6–7 minutes per side.
Combine the lettuce, tomato and cucumber in a bowl.
Slice the chicken into strips, slice the avocado and arrange everything.
Drizzle with olive oil, salt, pepper and a little lemon juice.

title: Tuna and Bean Salad
instructions: Rinse and drain the beans and sweetcorn.
Finely dice the pepper and onion.
Mix everything with the flaked tuna and season with olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.

title: Pumpkin and Lentil Soup
instructions: Dice the onion, pumpkin and carrot and sweat them briefly in a pot.
Add the lentils and 500 ml water and simmer for 15–20 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and blend until creamy.
Season with salt, pepper and curry powder.

title: Wholewheat Pasta with Turkey Mince Sauce
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Finely dice the onion and carrot and fry in olive oil.
Add the turkey mince and fry until crumbly.
Add the passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Cod with Potatoes and Green Beans
instructions: Peel the potatoes, cut them into pieces and boil for 15 minutes.
Add the beans for the last 6 minutes.
Fry the cod in olive oil for 3–4 minutes per side and season with salt, pepper and lemon.
Arrange everything together.

title: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Rice
instructions: Cook the rice in salted water.
Dice the tofu and fry in rapeseed oil until crisp.
Cut the vegetables into pieces, add them and fry for 5 minutes.
Deglaze with soy sauce and serve with the rice.

title: Stuffed Peppers with Minced Beef
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional) and cook the rice.
Halve and deseed the peppers.
Brown the mince with the onion, mix with the rice and passata and season.
Fill the pepper halves, top with mozzarella and bake for 25 minutes.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Curry
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Dice the chicken and fry it in a pan with the curry powder.
Add the pepper and courgette and fry for another 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 8 minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Turkey Breast with Sweet Potato Mash
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potato and boil for 15 minutes until soft.
Cook or steam the broccoli along with it for the last 6 minutes.
Fry the turkey breast in rapeseed oil for 5–6 minutes per side.
Mash the sweet potatoes with the milk, season with salt and arrange everything.

title: Lentil Bolognese with Wholewheat Pasta
instructions: Finely dice the onion and carrot and fry in olive oil.
Add the lentils, passata and 150 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta and toss it with the sauce.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Salmon Quinoa Bowl with Edamame
instructions: Rinse the quinoa under hot water and cook in twice the amount of water for 12 minutes.
Boil the edamame in salted water for 4 minutes.
Fry the salmon in a pan for 4 minutes per side.
Arrange everything in a bowl with cucumber slices and drizzle with soy sauce.

title: Aubergine and Mince Bake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional).
Slice the aubergine and fry briefly in olive oil.
Brown the mince with the onion and season with the passata.
Layer alternately in a baking dish, top with mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes.

title: Hummus with Vegetable Sticks
instructions: Cut the carrot, cucumber and pepper into sticks.
Spoon the hummus into a small bowl and serve with the vegetables.

title: Protein Banana Shake
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until creamy and serve immediately.

title: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple
instructions: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Dice the pineapple, spread it on top and sprinkle with linseeds.

title: Edamame with Sea Salt
instructions: Boil the edamame in salted water for 4–5 minutes.
Drain, sprinkle with sea salt and serve warm.

title: Rice Cakes with Quark and Cucumber
instructions: Season the quark with salt and pepper.
Spread it on the rice cakes.
Top with cucumber slices and chives.

title: Skyr with Berries and Dark Chocolate
instructions: Spoon the skyr into a bowl.
Spread the berries on top.
Finely chop the chocolate and sprinkle it over.

title: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Pepper and Hummus
instructions: Boil the eggs for 9–10 minutes until hard, cool them in cold water and peel.
Cut the pepper into strips.
Halve the eggs and serve with the pepper and hummus.

title: Green Protein Smoothie
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a high-speed blender.
Blend until smooth, about 1 minute.
Serve immediately or top up with ice cubes.

title: Berry Skyr Smoothie
instructions: Put the berries, skyr, milk and oats into the blender.
Blend until creamy and drink straight away.

title: Chocolate Peanut Protein Shake
instructions: Put all the ingredients into a blender.
Blend for 30 seconds until creamy and serve immediately.

title: Mango Yoghurt Smoothie
instructions: Cut the mango into pieces and peel the orange.
Blend everything with the yoghurt and water until smooth.
Serve immediately.

title: Berry Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend the berries, banana and skyr in a blender until very thick (use only a little liquid).
Pour into a bowl.
Top with oats and chopped almonds.

title: Protein Banana Ice Cream
instructions: Slice the banana and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Blend with the protein powder and milk until creamy.
Eat straight away as soft serve or freeze for 30 minutes.

title: Strawberry Frozen Yoghurt
instructions: Blend the frozen strawberries with the yoghurt and honey until smooth.
Serve straight away as soft serve or freeze for 1 hour.
Let it soften briefly before serving.

title: Chocolate Protein Ice Cream
instructions: Stir all the ingredients until smooth and pour into a tub.
Freeze for at least 6 hours.
Let it soften for 10 minutes before serving and scoop into balls.

title: Mango Lassi Ice Cream
instructions: Blend the frozen mango with the yoghurt and honey until creamy.
Serve straight away or freeze briefly.

title: Air Fryer Chicken with Sweet Potato Wedges
instructions: Cut the sweet potato into wedges and toss with rapeseed oil and paprika.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 20 minutes, turning halfway.
Season the chicken and cook it along with the wedges for the last 12 minutes.
Stir the quark with salt and herbs to make a dip and serve alongside.

title: Air Fryer Salmon with Broccoli and Potatoes
instructions: Dice the potatoes and pre-cook them in the air fryer at 200°C for 10 minutes.
Toss the broccoli with olive oil and add it to the potatoes.
Season the salmon, place it on top and cook for another 8–10 minutes.
Drizzle with lemon.

title: Air Fryer Chickpea Crunch
instructions: Rinse the chickpeas and pat them thoroughly dry.
Toss with olive oil and the spices.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until crisp, shaking now and then.

title: Air Fryer Courgette Fries with Parmesan
instructions: Cut the courgette into fry-shaped strips.
Dip first in the egg white, then in the mixture of ground oats and Parmesan.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 12 minutes until crisp.

title: Air Fryer Protein Nuggets
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season.
Coat first in the egg white, then in the ground oats.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 12 minutes, turning halfway.
Serve with salad and quark dip.

title: Air Fryer Falafel Bowl
instructions: Coarsely blend the chickpeas, onion, oats and spices (cumin, parsley).
Shape into small balls.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 12 minutes.
Arrange in a bowl with cucumber, tomato and yoghurt dip.

title: Air Fryer Prawn Skewers with Rice
instructions: Cook the rice in salted water.
Thread the prawns, courgette and pepper alternately onto skewers and brush with olive oil and spices.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 8–10 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

title: Air Fryer Tofu with Rice and Broccoli
instructions: Pat the tofu dry, dice it and toss with soy sauce and rapeseed oil.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 15 minutes until crisp, shaking now and then.
Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.
Arrange everything in a bowl.

title: Air Fryer Potato Wedges with Herb Quark
instructions: Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with olive oil and salt.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 20 minutes until crisp.
Stir the quark with chives, salt and pepper and serve alongside.

title: Chocolate Banana Protein Overnight Oats
instructions: Stir the oats, protein powder, cocoa, chia seeds and milk together in a jar.
Leave to soak overnight in the fridge.
Top with banana slices.

title: Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
instructions: Stir all the ingredients except the chocolate into a smooth batter in a large mug.
Roughly chop the chocolate and fold it in.
Cook in the microwave at 800 watts for 90 seconds.
Let it cool briefly and eat straight from the mug.

title: Protein Pizza with Quark Dough
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional).
Knead the quark, flour and a pinch of salt into a dough and roll it out thinly.
Spread with passata and top with turkey, pepper and mozzarella.
Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Cottage Cheese Flatbread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional).
Blend the cottage cheese and eggs with salt and pepper until smooth.
Spread thinly on a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake for 25 minutes.
Top with tomato and avocado.

title: Protein Cheesecake in a Jar
instructions: Stir the skyr, quark and honey until smooth.
Put the oats into a glass as the base.
Spread the cream on top and finish with berries.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

title: High-Protein Chilli con Carne
instructions: Dice the onion and pepper and fry them in a pot.
Add the mince and fry until crumbly.
Add the beans, sweetcorn, passata and spices (chilli, cumin, paprika).
Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Chicken Burrito Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice.
Season the chicken (paprika, cumin), fry it in a pan, then cut into strips.
Arrange all the ingredients in a bowl and drizzle with lime juice.

title: Tuna Cucumber Boats
instructions: Halve the cucumber and hollow it out with a spoon.
Mix the tuna with the yoghurt and mashed avocado and season.
Fill the mixture into the cucumber halves.

title: Apple Cinnamon Protein Porridge
instructions: Bring the oats and milk to the boil, stirring.
Take the pan off the heat and let it cool briefly.
Stir in the protein powder.
Top with diced apple and cinnamon.

title: Oven-Roasted Chicken with Vegetables (Traybake)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional).
Dice the potatoes, cut the vegetables into pieces and toss with olive oil on a baking tray.
Season the chicken and add it to the tray.
Bake for 25–30 minutes.

title: Egg Muffins with Spinach and Feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (conventional).
Whisk the eggs and egg whites and season.
Divide the pepper, spinach and feta between the muffin cups and pour the egg mixture over.
Bake for 20 minutes.

title: Protein Energy Balls
instructions: Knead all the ingredients into a mouldable mixture.
Shape into 4 small balls.
Chill for at least 30 minutes.

title: Scrambled Eggs with Smoked Salmon on Wholegrain Toast
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the rapeseed oil in a pan and cook the eggs over low heat, stirring, until creamy and just set.
Toast the bread and top with the scrambled eggs.
Lay the smoked salmon on top and sprinkle with chives.

title: Quark Rolls with Cream Cheese and Cucumber
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (fan).
Knead the quark, oats, flour, protein powder, egg, baking powder and a pinch of salt into a dough.
Shape into two rolls and bake for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.
Let them cool, slice open and fill with cream cheese and cucumber slices.

title: Chicken Skewers with Yoghurt Marinade and Couscous
instructions: Dice the chicken and marinate with the yoghurt, salt, pepper and paprika for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the chicken onto skewers with pieces of pepper and courgette.
Fry the skewers in olive oil in a griddle pan for 10–12 minutes, turning on all sides.
Pour boiling water over the couscous, leave to swell for 5 minutes and serve alongside.

title: Beef Steak with Roast Vegetables and Herb Quark
instructions: Preheat the oven to 210°C (conventional).
Cut the potatoes, courgette and pepper into pieces, toss with olive oil and roast for 25 minutes.
Pat the steak dry, salt it and sear for 2–3 minutes per side, then let it rest for 3 minutes.
Stir the quark with salt, pepper and fresh herbs.
Slice the steak and serve with the vegetables and herb quark.

title: Turkey Strips with Mushrooms and Rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Cut the turkey into strips, sear in rapeseed oil over high heat, then remove from the pan.
Fry the onion and mushrooms until they take on colour.
Return the turkey to the pan, stir in the yoghurt and warm over low heat for 3 minutes (do not boil).
Season with salt, pepper and parsley and serve with the rice.

title: Sesame Tuna with Pak Choi and Rice
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Pat the tuna dry and roll it in sesame seeds on all sides.
Sear in rapeseed oil for 1 minute per side; the centre should stay pink.
Halve the pak choi and cook in the pan with a little soy sauce for 3 minutes.
Slice the tuna and arrange with the rice and pak choi.

title: Chicken Gyros in Pita with Tzatziki
instructions: Cut the chicken into thin strips and season with salt, pepper, oregano and paprika.
Fry vigorously in olive oil in a hot pan for 6–7 minutes.
Grate the cucumber and stir it into the yoghurt with a little garlic to make tzatziki.
Warm the pita, cut it open and fill with the chicken, tomato, onion rings and tzatziki.

title: Protein Waffles with Skyr and Raspberries
instructions: Stir the oats, egg, quark, protein powder and baking powder into a thick batter.
Cook in batches in a hot waffle iron until golden brown.
Serve the waffles with skyr and fresh raspberries.

title: Korean-Style Beef Mince Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook the rice.
Fry the mince in rapeseed oil until crumbly and season with soy sauce, garlic and ginger.
Slice the cucumber and cut the carrot into thin strips.
Fry the egg sunny side up.
Arrange the rice, mince, vegetables and egg in a bowl and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Omelette Wrap with Turkey Ham and Spinach
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and cook into a thin omelette in a non-stick pan.
Warm the wrap briefly and spread with cream cheese.
Add the omelette, turkey ham and spinach.
Roll up tightly and cut in half diagonally.

title: Protein Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Whip the quark, protein powder and cocoa with a hand mixer for 2 minutes until very smooth and airy.
Spoon into a glass and chill for at least 1 hour.
Garnish with raspberries and grated chocolate.

title: Chicken Caesar Salad with Yoghurt Dressing
instructions: Season the chicken and fry in a pan for 6–7 minutes per side.
Dice the bread and toast in a dry pan to make croutons.
Stir the yoghurt with lemon juice, mustard, a little Parmesan and pepper to make the dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and top with chicken strips, croutons and Parmesan shavings.

title: Oven-Baked Pollock with Herb Crust and Creamed Spinach
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional) and boil the potatoes.
Mix the panko with olive oil, chopped parsley and lemon zest.
Season the pollock, top with the crust and bake for 15 minutes.
Wilt the spinach in a pan and stir in the cream cheese, salt and nutmeg until creamy.
Arrange everything with the potatoes.

title: Tempeh Bowl with Sweet Potato and Edamame
instructions: Dice the sweet potato and roast in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Rinse the quinoa under hot water and cook in twice the amount of water for 12 minutes.
Slice the tempeh, fry it in rapeseed oil until crisp and deglaze with soy sauce.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes.
Arrange everything in a bowl with avocado slices.

title: Spaghetti with Tuna Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Sauté the onion in olive oil until translucent and add the passata.
Simmer the sauce for 8 minutes, then stir in the tuna and olives.
Toss with the spaghetti and serve with parsley.

title: Sweet Protein Omelette with Quark and Blueberries
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and cook into an omelette in rapeseed oil in a pan.
Stir the quark until smooth and spread it over one half.
Scatter the blueberries over, fold the omelette and drizzle with honey.

title: Turkey Patties with Cucumber Salad and Potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes.
Knead the mince with the egg, oats, finely diced onion, salt and pepper and shape into patties.
Fry in rapeseed oil for 5–6 minutes per side.
Thinly slice the cucumber and dress with yoghurt, dill, salt and pepper.
Serve with the potatoes.

title: Protein Rice Pudding with Cinnamon and Apple
instructions: Bring the pudding rice to the boil with the milk and simmer over low heat for 20–25 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Dice the apple and stew with a little water and cinnamon for 5 minutes until soft.
Let the rice pudding cool slightly and stir in the protein powder until smooth.
Serve with the apple pieces and cinnamon.

title: Chicken Breast Stuffed with Spinach and Feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Cut a pocket into the side of the chicken breast.
Briefly fry the spinach, mix with the crumbled feta, fill the pocket and secure with toothpicks.
Bake with olive oil in a dish together with the potato wedges and cherry tomatoes for 25 minutes.

title: Garlic Prawns with Tomatoes and Toasted Bread
instructions: Slice the bread and toast in the oven or toaster until crisp.
Briefly sweat the garlic in olive oil, add the tomato pieces and simmer for 4 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3–4 minutes until pink.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the bread.

title: Tuna Melt on Wholegrain Bread
instructions: Preheat the oven grill to 200°C.
Mix the tuna with yoghurt, salt, pepper and a little lemon juice.
Top the bread slices with tomato slices and the tuna mixture.
Sprinkle with cheese and grill for 5–7 minutes until the cheese is golden brown.

title: Savoury Cottage Cheese Bowl with Egg and Radishes
instructions: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Slice the radishes and cucumber and arrange with the halved eggs.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds, chives and pepper.

title: Steak Salad with Rocket and Parmesan
instructions: Pat the steak dry, season and sear for 2–3 minutes per side, then let it rest for 3 minutes.
Arrange the rocket and halved tomatoes on a plate.
Slice the steak thinly and lay it on top.
Drizzle with Parmesan shavings, olive oil, balsamic vinegar and pepper and serve with the toasted bread.

title: Skyr Panna Cotta with Raspberry Sauce
instructions: Soak the gelatine in cold water.
Warm the milk, dissolve the gelatine in it and stir until smooth with the honey, skyr and protein powder.
Pour into a glass or ramekin and chill for 3 hours.
Crush the raspberries with a fork and spoon over as a sauce.

title: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs with Paprika Potatoes
instructions: Rub the chicken thighs with salt, pepper and paprika.
Cut the potatoes and pepper into pieces and toss with rapeseed oil.
Cook the thighs in the air fryer at 190°C for 12 minutes, then add the potatoes and pepper and cook for another 18 minutes.
Serve with yoghurt and herbs.

title: Light Air Fryer Cordon Bleu with Salad
instructions: Cut a pocket into the side of the chicken breast and fill with the ham and cheese.
Coat first in the egg white, then in the ground oats.
Cook in the air fryer at 180°C for 16–18 minutes, turning halfway.
Serve with salad and tomato.

title: Air Fryer Fish Fingers with Pea Mash
instructions: Cut the fish into finger-thick pieces, season, then dip first in egg white and then in panko.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 10–12 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Boil the potatoes and peas and mash into a coarse purée.
Stir the yoghurt with lemon juice, dill and salt to make a tartare-style sauce and serve alongside.

title: Air Fryer Halloumi Sticks with Tomato Salad
instructions: Cut the halloumi into finger-thick sticks and pat dry.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 6–8 minutes until golden brown.
Dice the tomato and cucumber and mix with mint, salt and pepper.
Drizzle the halloumi with honey and serve with the salad.

title: Air Fryer Cauliflower Wings with Hummus Dip
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets.
Stir the flour, soy milk, tomato purée and spices into a thick batter and coat the florets in it.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 15–18 minutes until crisp, shaking once.
Serve with hummus as a dip.

title: Air Fryer Broccoli Cheese Bites
instructions: Boil the broccoli in salted water for 4 minutes, drain and chop finely.
Knead with the egg, grated cheese, oats, salt and pepper and shape into small balls.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 12 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Serve with a yoghurt dip.

title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Fries with Avocado Dip
instructions: Cut the sweet potato into fries and toss with rapeseed oil, salt and paprika.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 18–20 minutes until crisp, shaking now and then.
Mash the avocado with the yoghurt, lime juice and salt into a creamy dip.
Serve the fries with the dip.

title: Air Fryer Brussels Sprouts with Parmesan and Walnuts
instructions: Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts and toss with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 12–14 minutes until the leaves are crisp.
Serve with honey, Parmesan shavings and chopped walnuts.

title: Air Fryer Teriyaki Salmon with Rice and Pak Choi
instructions: Stir together the soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic and marinate the salmon in it for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Cook the salmon in the air fryer at 180°C for 8–10 minutes.
Add the pak choi for the last 4 minutes.
Serve with the rice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Air Fryer Coconut Prawns with Mango Dip
instructions: Pat the prawns dry and season.
Coat first in the egg white, then in the mixture of desiccated coconut and panko.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 7–8 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Purée the mango finely and stir with the yoghurt and a little lime juice to make a dip.

title: Air Fryer Wrap Pizza with Turkey and Mushrooms
instructions: Spread the wrap with passata, oregano and salt.
Top with mozzarella, turkey, pepper strips and sliced mushrooms.
Bake in the air fryer at 190°C for 5–6 minutes until the cheese has melted and the edge is crisp.
Top with rocket and cut into pieces.

title: Air Fryer Frittata with Pepper and Feta
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and season with salt and pepper.
Finely chop the pepper, onion and spinach and stir them in.
Pour into a small ovenproof dish and sprinkle with feta.
Cook in the air fryer at 160°C for 15–18 minutes until set and golden on top.

title: Air Fryer Turkey Meatballs with Tomato Sauce and Pasta
instructions: Knead the mince with the egg, oats, diced onion, salt and pepper and shape into small balls.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 10–12 minutes.
Simmer the passata with oregano for 8 minutes and cook the pasta.
Mix everything together and sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Air Fryer Baked Apple with Vanilla Skyr
instructions: Core the apple and fill with chopped walnuts, honey and cinnamon.
Cook in the air fryer at 180°C for 15–18 minutes until soft.
Stir the skyr with a little vanilla and serve with the warm apple.

title: Air Fryer Oat and Banana Cookies
instructions: Mash the banana and knead with the oats, almonds, chocolate and cinnamon.
Shape four small cookies on baking paper.
Bake in the air fryer at 170°C for 10–12 minutes.
Let them cool on a wire rack.

title: Air Fryer Protein Bean Brownies
instructions: Rinse the kidney beans well and blend with the egg, maple syrup, cocoa and protein powder into a smooth batter.
Fold in the chopped chocolate.
Pour into a small dish and bake in the air fryer at 170°C for 15–18 minutes.
Let it cool and cut into pieces.

title: Air Fryer Sesame Tofu Nuggets with Rice
instructions: Press the tofu well, dice it and marinate in soy sauce.
Coat in the mixture of sesame seeds and ground oats.
Cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 15 minutes until crisp, shaking now and then.
Cook the rice and serve with cucumber slices and the tofu nuggets.

title: Air Fryer Jacket Potato with Herb Quark and Salmon
instructions: Wash the potatoes, prick them with a fork and cook in the air fryer at 200°C for 30–35 minutes.
Stir the quark with salt, pepper and chives.
Cut the potatoes open, fill with the quark and top with smoked salmon.
Serve with cucumber slices.

title: Air Fryer Cod with Lemon Crust and Asparagus
instructions: Mix the panko with olive oil, lemon zest and parsley.
Season the cod and top with the crust.
Boil the potatoes and pre-cook the asparagus in the air fryer at 190°C for 5 minutes.
Add the fish and cook for another 8–10 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Air Fryer Vegetable Crisps
instructions: Slice the vegetables wafer-thin with a mandoline.
Toss with olive oil and salt.
Cook in the air fryer at 160°C for 10–12 minutes until crisp, shaking often and removing the crisps as they are done.

title: Air Fryer Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Cut the chicken into strips and mix with the pepper, onion and fajita seasoning.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 12–14 minutes, shaking now and then.
Warm the wrap and fill with the mixture.
Serve with yoghurt and avocado slices.

title: Air Fryer Bean Quesadilla
instructions: Lightly mash the beans and mix with the sweetcorn, diced pepper and spices.
Spread on one half of the wrap, sprinkle with cheese and fold over.
Bake in the air fryer at 190°C for 6–8 minutes until golden brown, turning once.
Serve with tomato salsa.

title: Courgette Noodles with Prawn Tomato Sauce
instructions: Spiralise the courgette into noodles.
Fry the garlic in olive oil, fry the prawns for 3 minutes and remove them.
Simmer the passata for 5 minutes and warm the courgette noodles in it for 2 minutes.
Return the prawns and serve with Parmesan and basil.

title: Cauliflower Rice Stir-Fry with Egg and Vegetables
instructions: Finely grate the cauliflower or pulse it in a blender into rice-sized pieces.
Dice the carrot and fry with the peas in rapeseed oil for 4 minutes.
Add the cauliflower rice and fry for 5 minutes.
Scramble the eggs at the edge of the pan until set, mix everything together and season with soy sauce.

title: Light Minestrone
instructions: Finely dice the vegetables and sweat in olive oil for 4 minutes.
Add the passata and 400 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the beans and pasta and cook for another 8 minutes.
Serve with Parmesan and basil.

title: Light Greek Salad
instructions: Cut the cucumber, tomato and pepper into rough chunks.
Slice the onion into thin rings.
Toss everything in a bowl with the olives and top with the feta.
Dress with olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper.

title: Creamy Tomato Soup with Yoghurt
instructions: Dice the onion and carrot and sweat in olive oil.
Add the tomatoes and 200 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season with salt, pepper and a little basil.
Serve with a dollop of yoghurt and the toasted bread.

title: Clear Chicken Soup with Vegetables
instructions: Bring the chicken to the boil with 600 ml water and salt and simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Chop the vegetables and cook them in the soup for 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred it.
Cook the noodles in the soup, return the chicken and serve with parsley.

title: Courgette Boats Stuffed with Turkey Mince
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Halve the courgettes, scoop out the flesh with a spoon and chop it finely.
Fry the mince with the onion and courgette flesh and season with the passata and spices.
Fill into the courgette halves, top with mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes.

title: White Cabbage and Mince Skillet
instructions: Cut the white cabbage into thin strips and dice the onion.
Fry the mince in olive oil until crumbly and add the onion.
Stir in the tomato purée, add the cabbage and braise over medium heat for 12 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika and caraway.

title: Lentil Soup with Vegetables
instructions: Dice the onion, carrot and celery and sweat in olive oil.
Add the lentils, passata and 500 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt, cumin and lemon juice.
Serve with a dollop of yoghurt.

title: Roast Vegetables with Herby Cottage Cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Cut the vegetables into pieces and toss with olive oil, salt and herbs.
Roast on a baking tray for 25 minutes.
Stir the cottage cheese with chives and pepper and serve with the vegetables.

title: Thai Vegetable Soup with Prawns
instructions: Bring the coconut milk to the boil with 300 ml water, the ginger, lime juice and a teaspoon of curry paste.
Cook the mushrooms, pepper and pak choi in it for 5 minutes.
Add the prawns and let them poach for 3 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles separately, add them to the soup and serve with coriander.

title: Lettuce Wraps with Chicken and Peanut Sauce
instructions: Cut the chicken into strips and fry in a pan for 6–7 minutes.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into thin strips.
Stir the peanut butter with soy sauce, lime juice and a little water to make a sauce.
Fill the lettuce leaves with the chicken and vegetables and drizzle with the sauce.

title: Salmon and Cucumber Salad with Dill Yoghurt
instructions: Season the salmon and fry in a pan for 3–4 minutes per side.
Thinly slice the cucumber and radishes and mix with the rocket.
Stir the yoghurt with dill, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Break the salmon into pieces, arrange on the salad and drizzle with the dressing.

title: Mushroom Skillet with Spinach and Fried Egg
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and fry in rapeseed oil over high heat until golden brown.
Add the onion, then wilt the spinach.
Season with salt, pepper and thyme.
Fry the eggs and serve with the bread alongside the mushrooms.

title: Watermelon and Feta Salad
instructions: Dice the watermelon and cucumber.
Crumble the feta over the top.
Serve with pumpkin seeds, fresh mint and a little lime juice.

title: Carrot and Ginger Soup
instructions: Dice the onion, carrots and potato and sweat in olive oil.
Add the ginger and 500 ml water and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and blend until smooth.
Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.

title: Fennel and Orange Salad with Tuna
instructions: Slice the fennel wafer-thin.
Peel and segment the orange, catching the juice.
Arrange the fennel, orange, rocket and olives and scatter the tuna on top.
Drizzle with the orange juice, olive oil, salt and pepper.

title: Cucumber and Salmon Rolls
instructions: Use a vegetable peeler to slice the cucumber into long, thin ribbons.
Stir the cream cheese with dill, lemon juice and pepper.
Spread the ribbons with cream cheese, top with smoked salmon and roll up.
Secure with toothpicks and serve chilled.

title: Light Tiramisu in a Glass
instructions: Stir the quark, cream cheese and honey until smooth and creamy.
Roughly break the ladyfingers and briefly dip them in cold espresso.
Layer the biscuits and cream alternately in a glass.
Chill for at least 2 hours and dust with cocoa before serving.

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg and Chilli
instructions: Keep water with a dash of vinegar just below simmering and poach the eggs one at a time for 3–4 minutes.
Toast the bread and spread with mashed avocado.
Top with tomato halves and the poached eggs.
Season with chilli flakes, salt and pepper.

title: Avocado Toast with Feta and Honey
instructions: Toast the bread and spread with mashed avocado.
Slice the tomato and lay it on top.
Crumble the feta over, drizzle with honey and sprinkle with pepper and thyme.

title: Shakshuka with Feta
instructions: Dice the onion and pepper and fry in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika and passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make hollows in the sauce, crack in the eggs and cook, covered, for 6–8 minutes until set.
Top with feta and parsley and serve with the bread.

title: Salmon Poke Bowl
instructions: Cook the sushi rice and let it cool.
Dice the salmon and marinate in soy sauce and sesame seeds.
Slice or cut the cucumber, carrot and avocado into strips and cook the edamame.
Arrange all the ingredients in rows on top of the rice.

title: Cauliflower Schnitzel with Potato and Cucumber Salad
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into 1.5 cm thick steaks and pre-cook in salted water for 5 minutes.
Pat dry, then dip in beaten egg and panko.
Fry in rapeseed oil for 4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Boil the potatoes, slice them and mix with the cucumber, yoghurt, dill and salt to make a salad.

title: Roasted Pumpkin Soup with Seeds and Yoghurt
instructions: Dice the pumpkin and onion, toss with olive oil and roast in the oven at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Simmer with the potato and 400 ml water for 10 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and blend until smooth.
Serve with yoghurt, toasted pumpkin seeds and pepper.

title: Baked Feta Pasta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Put the tomatoes and feta in a baking dish with olive oil, season and bake for 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta.
Stir the feta and tomatoes into a creamy sauce and fold in the spinach and pasta.

title: Gnocchi Skillet with Spinach and Mozzarella
instructions: Fry the gnocchi in olive oil for 5–6 minutes until golden brown.
Halve the tomatoes and fry them along with the gnocchi for 3 minutes.
Fold in the spinach and let it wilt.
Add the mozzarella in pieces and the pesto and let it melt briefly.

title: Light Käsespätzle (Cheese Spätzle)
instructions: Slice the onion into thin rings and slowly fry in rapeseed oil until golden brown.
Warm the spätzle in a pan.
Stir in the cheese and let it melt.
Sprinkle with the fried onions and serve with salad.

title: Protein Kaiserschmarrn with Apple Sauce
instructions: Separate the eggs and whisk the whites until stiff.
Stir the yolks with the quark, flour, protein powder and milk into a smooth batter and fold in the egg whites.
Cook the batter on both sides in rapeseed oil in a pan over medium heat and tear into pieces with two forks.
Dust with a little icing sugar and serve with apple sauce.

title: Creamy Scrambled Eggs on Brioche
instructions: Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Cook very slowly in a non-stick pan over low heat, stirring constantly, until creamy and just set.
Stir in the cream cheese.
Toast the brioche, arrange the scrambled eggs on top and sprinkle with chives.

title: Lighter Burger with Wholegrain Bun
instructions: Season the mince with salt and pepper and shape into a flat patty.
Fry in a hot pan for 3–4 minutes per side, melting the cheese on top at the end.
Cut the bun open and toast briefly.
Top with yoghurt sauce, lettuce, tomato, onion and cucumber.

title: Flammkuchen Wraps with Ham and Onions
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C (conventional).
Place the wraps on a baking tray and spread with soured cream.
Top with onion rings and ham strips and bake for 8–10 minutes until crisp.
Sprinkle with chives and pepper.

title: Bruschetta with Tomatoes and Cottage Cheese
instructions: Toast the bread.
Finely dice the tomatoes and mix with olive oil, basil, salt and pepper.
Spread the bread with cottage cheese and top with the tomatoes.
Serve with Parmesan shavings.

title: Apple Crumble in a Glass with Vanilla Quark
instructions: Dice the apple and stew with cinnamon and 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes until soft.
Toast the oats, almonds and honey in a pan until golden brown (crumble).
Stir the quark with vanilla until smooth.
Layer the apple, quark and crumble alternately in a glass.

title: Overnight Oats with Peach and Almonds
instructions: Stir the oats, low-fat quark and milk together in a screw-top jar.
Close the jar and leave to soak in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, dice the peach and add it on top with flaked almonds and honey.
Close the jar and eat straight from the jar at the office.

title: Vegan Overnight Oats with Blueberries and Coconut
instructions: Stir the oats, oat drink, chia seeds and maple syrup together in the jar.
Leave to soak in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, add blueberries and coconut flakes on top.
Close the jar tightly and take it to the office chilled.

title: Tiramisu Overnight Oats
instructions: Stir the oats with the milk and cold espresso in the jar.
Stir the quark with maple syrup until smooth and add as a second layer.
Chill overnight.
Dust with cocoa powder before eating.

title: Carrot Cake Overnight Oats
instructions: Stir the oats, yoghurt, milk, maple syrup and cinnamon together in the jar.
Fold in the grated carrot.
Leave to infuse in the fridge overnight.
Top with chopped walnuts before eating.

title: Bircher Muesli with Apple and Hazelnuts
instructions: Mix the oats, yoghurt and milk the evening before.
Coarsely grate the apple, skin and all, and stir it in.
Chill overnight, covered.
Top with chopped hazelnuts and honey and eat from the jar.

title: Chocolate Banana Chia Pudding with Raspberries
instructions: Mash the banana finely with a fork and stir until smooth with the milk, quark, cocoa powder and maple syrup.
Stir in the chia seeds and stir again after 5 minutes.
Leave to soak in the fridge for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with fresh raspberries and take the jar with you, closed.

title: Vegan Coconut Pineapple Chia Pudding
instructions: Mash the banana finely and stir with the coconut milk, soy milk and maple syrup.
Stir in the chia seeds and stir again after 5 minutes.
Leave to soak in the fridge overnight.
Dice the pineapple and add it on top with coconut flakes.

title: Protein Muffins with Apple and Cinnamon
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (fan) and grease three cups of a muffin tin.
Mix the oats, protein powder, cinnamon and baking powder.
Stir together the egg, quark and grated apple and combine with the dry ingredients to make a batter.
Fill the batter into the cups, sprinkle with walnuts and bake for 20–25 minutes.
Let them cool. They keep for 3 days in the fridge and travel well in a box.

title: Egg Muffins with Turkey Ham and Courgette
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (fan) and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites and season with salt and pepper.
Divide the ham, courgette and cheese between the cups and top up with the egg mixture.
Bake for 15–18 minutes until the muffins are set.
Let them cool, pack in a box and eat with the bread. At the office, warm briefly in the microwave or eat cold.

title: Meal Prep Breakfast Burrito with Egg and Beans
instructions: Whisk the eggs and egg whites and cook in a pan into firm scrambled eggs.
Warm the kidney beans with the passata, salt, pepper and paprika for 3 minutes.
Fill the wrap with the scrambled eggs, beans and cheese, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Wrap in baking paper. Keeps for 2 days in the fridge; at the office, warm for 45 seconds in the microwave.

title: Peanut Banana Wrap with Skyr
instructions: Spread the wrap with peanut butter and skyr.
Lay the banana lengthways on the wrap and dust with cinnamon.
Roll up tightly and cut in half diagonally.
Wrap in baking paper and take it with you.

title: Make-Ahead Apple Oat Pancakes with Yoghurt
instructions: Mix the oats, flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Stir together the egg, quark, milk and grated apple and combine with the dry ingredients to make a batter.
Cook six small pancakes in a non-stick pan with a little oil until golden brown.
Let them cool and pack in a box, with the yoghurt and honey in a separate pot. Eat cold at the office or warm briefly.

title: Skyr Bowl with Kiwi and Crunchy Muesli
instructions: Put the skyr in a bowl or box and smooth it out.
Peel and slice the kiwi.
Pack the muesli and pumpkin seeds separately so they stay crunchy.
At the office, add the kiwi, muesli and seeds on top of the skyr.

title: Oat Bars with Dates and Almond Butter
instructions: Blend the dates with a little warm water and the almond butter into a sticky paste.
Knead in the oats, coconut flakes and pumpkin seeds.
Press the mixture into a small tin and bake at 170°C for 15 minutes.
Let it cool and cut into two bars. Keeps for several days in a box.

title: Bagel with Cream Cheese, Smoked Salmon and Cucumber
instructions: Cut the bagel open and spread both halves with cream cheese.
Thinly slice the cucumber and radishes and lay them on the bottom half with the rocket.
Lay the smoked salmon on top and season with dill and pepper.
Close the bagel and wrap in baking paper.

title: Courgette and Tomato Frittata Squares
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (fan) and line a small baking dish with baking paper.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites and season with salt, pepper and basil.
Put the courgette, tomato and torn mozzarella into the dish and pour the egg mixture over.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until the frittata is set.
Let it cool, cut into pieces and take with you in a box. Delicious cold or warm.

title: Skyr Seeded Rolls with Turkey Ham
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C (fan).
Mix the flour, baking powder, linseed, pumpkin seeds and salt.
Add the skyr and egg and knead into a firm dough.
Shape two rolls and bake for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.
Let them cool, cut open and fill with turkey ham and cucumber.

title: Protein French Toast Sticks with Berry Dip
instructions: Whisk the egg, egg white, milk and cinnamon in a shallow plate.
Cut the toast into strips and briefly turn in the egg mixture.
Fry in a non-stick pan with a little oil until golden brown.
Crush the raspberries with a fork and stir with the skyr to make a dip.
Let the sticks cool, put them in a box and pack the dip separately. Eat cold or briefly warmed at the office.

title: Millet Breakfast Jar with Pear and Cinnamon
instructions: Rinse the millet in hot water and simmer in the milk with cinnamon for 12 minutes until soft, then let it cool.
Dice the pear.
Layer the millet, yoghurt and pear in a jar.
Top with chopped hazelnuts. Keeps in the fridge until the next day.

title: Air Fryer Egg-in-a-Hole with Tomato
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 180°C.
Cut a round hole out of the middle of two slices of toast and lightly oil the slices.
Place the toast in the air fryer, crack an egg into each hole and sprinkle with cheese.
Cook for 6–8 minutes until the egg white is set.
Serve with tomato slices.

title: Vegan Chickpea Scramble Wrap with Spinach
instructions: Sauté the onion in rapeseed oil until translucent.
Roughly mash the chickpeas with a fork and fry with the turmeric, cumin, salt and pepper for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and let it wilt.
Spread the wrap with hummus, fill with the chickpea mixture and tomato and roll up tightly.
Wrap in baking paper and eat cold or warmed.

title: Yoghurt Muesli Parfait with Cherries
instructions: Stone and halve the cherries.
Layer the yoghurt, cherries and muesli alternately in a tall glass.
Add the flaked almonds on top.
If you like it crunchy, pack the muesli separately and add it at the office.

title: Mason Jar Salad with Chicken and Sweetcorn
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in hot water, cook in twice the amount of water for 12 minutes and let it cool.
Season the chicken, fry in a pan for 12 minutes until cooked through, then dice.
Stir the yoghurt, mustard, olive oil, salt and pepper together to make the dressing.
Layer in the jar: dressing, quinoa, sweetcorn, carrot, tomatoes, chicken, with the lettuce on top.
At the office, shake the jar or tip it out onto a plate.

title: Mason Jar Salad with Chickpeas and Feta
instructions: Stir the olive oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper and a little oregano together in the jar.
Rinse the chickpeas and add them to the jar as the first layer.
Grate the carrot, dice the tomatoes and layer on top with the crumbled feta.
Add the rocket on top and close the jar. Keeps chilled for 2 days.

title: Bento Box with Chicken, Rice and Broccoli
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions and let it cool.
Cut the chicken into strips, fry in rapeseed oil and deglaze with soy sauce.
Steam the broccoli and carrot for 4 minutes.
Arrange everything in the compartments of a bento box and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
At the office, eat cold or warm in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Bento Box with Omelette and Edamame
instructions: Cook the rice and let it cool.
Whisk the eggs with a little soy sauce, cook in thin layers into a rolled omelette and cut into pieces.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes and let them cool.
Put the rice with nori strips in the box and arrange the omelette, edamame and cucumber slices alongside.

title: Chicken Wrap with Yoghurt Mustard Sauce
instructions: Season the chicken, fry in a pan for 10–12 minutes until cooked through, then cut into strips.
Stir the yoghurt with mustard, salt and pepper to make the sauce.
Spread the wrap with the sauce and top with lettuce, tomato, cucumber and chicken.
Roll up tightly, cut in half and wrap in baking paper.

title: Turkey and Cream Cheese Wrap Rolls with Spinach
instructions: Lay the wrap flat and spread evenly with cream cheese.
Scatter the sliced turkey, spinach, carrot and pepper strips over it.
Roll up tightly and chill in cling film so the roll holds its shape.
Cut into 2 cm thick rolls and take them with you in a box.

title: Hummus and Vegetable Sandwich on Wholegrain Bread
instructions: Spread both slices of bread thickly with hummus.
Thinly slice the cucumber and tomato.
Lay the vegetables and rocket on one slice and season with salt and pepper.
Top with the second slice, cut in half and wrap in baking paper.

title: Caprese Sandwich on Ciabatta
instructions: Cut the ciabatta open and drizzle the cut sides with olive oil.
Slice the mozzarella and tomatoes and salt lightly.
Layer on the bottom half with basil and rocket.
Season with pepper, close and wrap in baking paper. Pat the tomato slices dry beforehand so the bread doesn't go soggy.

title: Tuna Sandwich with Yoghurt Dressing and Cucumber
instructions: Drain the tuna well and stir with yoghurt, mustard, sweetcorn, salt and pepper into a creamy spread.
Cut the roll open.
Top the bottom half with cucumber slices and add the tuna spread.
Close the roll and wrap in baking paper.

title: Chicken and Apple Sandwich with Celery
instructions: Season the chicken, fry in a pan for 10–12 minutes, let it cool and dice finely.
Finely dice the apple and celery, mix with the chicken and yoghurt and season with salt and pepper.
Lightly toast the bread and top with lettuce.
Add the chicken salad, close and cut in half diagonally.

title: Pasta Salad with Peas and Turkey Ham
instructions: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Stir the yoghurt with mustard, salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Mix the pasta, peas, ham and diced pepper with the dressing.
Leave to marinate for at least 1 hour and take it with you cold in a box.

title: Quinoa Salad with Beetroot and Feta
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in hot water, cook in twice the amount of water for 12 minutes and let it cool.
Dice the beetroot.
Stir the olive oil with lemon juice, salt and pepper and mix into the quinoa.
Fold in the beetroot, rocket, crumbled feta and chopped walnuts. Beetroot stains, so it's best carried in a glass container.

title: Vegan Beluga Lentil Salad with Vegetables
instructions: Cook the lentils according to the packet instructions for 20 minutes until al dente, drain and let them cool.
Finely dice the cucumber, tomatoes, pepper and onion.
Stir the olive oil with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Mix everything with the lentils and the chopped parsley and take it with you cold in a box.

title: Couscous Box with Chickpeas and Courgette
instructions: Pour the same amount of hot water over the couscous, leave to swell for 5 minutes, then fluff up.
Dice the courgette and fry in olive oil in a pan for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and finely chopped sun-dried tomatoes.
Mix everything with the couscous, lemon juice, salt, pepper and mint.
Sprinkle with almonds and eat cold or lukewarm.

title: Cold Rice Bowl with Mango and Smoked Tofu
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions and let it cool.
Dice the smoked tofu, mango, pepper and cucumber.
Stir the soy sauce with lime juice.
Arrange everything in a bowl or box, drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Vegetable Sushi Rolls with Avocado and Carrot
instructions: Cook the sushi rice and let it cool slightly.
Lay the nori sheet smooth side down and spread the rice thinly over it, leaving 2 cm free at the top.
Cut the avocado, cucumber and carrot into strips and lay them on the rice.
Roll up tightly, seal with wet fingers and cut into 8 pieces with a sharp knife.
Take them with you in a box with soy sauce in a small container.

title: Vegetable Dip Box with Herb Quark and Egg
instructions: Hard-boil the egg for 9 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Cut the carrot, kohlrabi, cucumber and pepper into sticks.
Stir the quark with chives, salt and pepper and fill into a small pot.
Pack everything in a box with the bread.

title: Light Tortilla de Patatas
instructions: Peel the potatoes, slice thinly and pre-cook for 8 minutes.
Sweat the onion in olive oil until translucent and briefly fry the potatoes with it.
Whisk the eggs and egg whites, season with salt and pour over the potatoes.
Cook over low heat for 6 minutes until set, turn using a plate and fry for another 4 minutes.
Let it cool and cut into pieces. Best eaten cold.

title: Pea and Mint Soup with Yoghurt
instructions: Sweat the onion in olive oil, add the diced potato and stock and boil for 10 minutes.
Add the peas and mint and cook for 4 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season with salt and pepper.
Pour hot into a thermos container and take the yoghurt separately, adding it only at the office.
Eat with the bread.

title: Tuscan White Bean Soup
instructions: Finely dice the onion, carrot and celery and fry in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the passata, stock, beans and rosemary.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes and mash some of the beans so the soup becomes creamy.
Season with salt and pepper and pour hot into the thermos container.
Take the Parmesan separately and grate it over to serve.

title: Cream of Broccoli and Almond Soup
instructions: Sweat the onion in olive oil until translucent, add the diced potato and stock and boil for 8 minutes.
Add the broccoli florets and cook for another 7 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan and take them separately.
Pour the soup hot into the thermos container and top with the almonds at the office.

title: Salmon Glass Noodle Salad with Cucumber and Sesame
instructions: Season the salmon and fry in a pan for 4 minutes per side, then let it cool and flake into pieces.
Soak the rice noodles according to the packet instructions, drain and rinse under cold water.
Cut the cucumber and pepper into thin strips.
Stir the soy sauce with lime juice and mix with the noodles and vegetables.
Gently fold in the salmon and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Take it with you cold in a box.

title: Air Fryer Carrot and Courgette Fritters with Skyr Dip
instructions: Mix the courgette with salt, leave for 5 minutes and squeeze out well.
Stir with the carrot, egg, flour, salt and pepper into a mixture.
Shape small fritters, place them on baking paper in the air fryer and oil lightly.
Cook at 180°C for 12–14 minutes until golden brown and crisp, turning halfway.
Stir the skyr with herbs and salt to make the dip.

title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Hummus Wrap
instructions: Cut the sweet potato into sticks and toss with oil and paprika.
Cook in the air fryer at 190°C for 15–18 minutes until crisp, shaking now and then.
Spread the wrap with hummus and lay the spinach and sweet potato sticks on top.
Roll up tightly, cut in half and wrap in baking paper. Delicious warm or cold.

title: Turkey and Mango Salad with Bulgur and Cashews
instructions: Pour twice the amount of boiling water over the bulgur, leave to swell for 10 minutes and let it cool.
Season the turkey, fry in a pan for 10 minutes and cut into strips.
Stir the yoghurt with lime juice, salt and pepper to make the dressing.
Dice the mango and cucumber.
Layer everything with the bulgur and lettuce in a box and sprinkle the cashews over only at the office.

title: Cauliflower Tabbouleh with Chicken
instructions: Pulse the cauliflower in a mini chopper into rice-sized pieces.
Season the chicken, fry in a pan for 10–12 minutes and cut into strips.
Finely dice the cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix everything with chopped herbs, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Take it with you cold in a box; it tastes even better after a few hours.

title: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Salad with Yoghurt Tahini
instructions: Dice the sweet potato, toss with the spices and roast in the oven at 200°C for 20–25 minutes.
Rinse the chickpeas and roast them along for the last 10 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with tahini, lemon juice, salt and a little water into a smooth dressing.
Mix the spinach and onion rings with the sweet potato and chickpeas and pack the dressing separately.

title: Summer Rolls with Prawns and Peanut Dip
instructions: Soak and drain the rice noodles and cut the carrot and cucumber into thin strips.
Stir the peanut butter with soy sauce, lime juice and a little warm water into a smooth dip.
Briefly soak the rice paper in warm water and lay it out on a damp board.
Add the lettuce, noodles, vegetables and prawns, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Put the summer rolls in the box wrapped in damp kitchen paper and take the dip separately.

title: Turkish Menemen with Flatbread
instructions: Chop the onion and pointed pepper and dice the tomatoes.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and soften the onion and pepper for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and reduce for 6–8 minutes until a thick sauce forms.
Crack the eggs straight into the pan, season with salt and chilli flakes and let them set loosely over low heat, stirring only lightly.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve in the pan with the flatbread.

title: Lebanese Manakish with Za'atar and Tomato
instructions: Knead the flour with the yoghurt, half a sachet of dried yeast, a pinch of salt and 40 ml lukewarm water into a smooth dough and leave to rise, covered, for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 230°C (conventional).
Stir the za'atar with the olive oil into a paste.
Roll the dough out into a thin round flatbread, spread with the paste and bake for 10–12 minutes.
Slice the tomato and cucumber and serve with olives and mint alongside the warm flatbread.

title: Turkish Breakfast Plate with White Cheese and Olives
instructions: Hard-boil the egg for 8 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Slice the tomato and cucumber and arrange on a plate.
Add the white cheese, olives and the halved egg.
Tear the flatbread into pieces or toast briefly and serve with a little honey.

title: Labneh with Za'atar, Olive Oil and Cucumber
instructions: Spread the labneh in a shallow bowl, making a well with the back of a spoon.
Drizzle olive oil into the well and sprinkle with za'atar.
Slice the cucumber and tomato and briefly warm the pitta.
Arrange with olives and mint and dip the bread into the labneh.

title: Egyptian Ful Medames with Egg and Tahini
instructions: Heat the broad beans with 50 ml water and cumin for 8 minutes and roughly mash with a fork.
Finely dice the onion and stir the tahini with lemon juice and 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Mix the lemon juice and half of the olive oil into the beans and season with salt and pepper.
Arrange on a plate with the onion, parsley, tahini sauce and the halved egg and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Serve with flatbread.

title: Pan con Tomate with Serrano Ham
instructions: Toast the bread slices in a toaster or pan until crisp.
Halve the garlic clove and rub it over the hot surface of the bread.
Grate the tomatoes on a coarse grater and spread over the bread.
Drizzle with olive oil and a little salt and top with Serrano ham.

title: Moroccan Baghrir with Orange and Honey
instructions: Blend the semolina, flour, yoghurt, milk, yeast, baking powder, a pinch of salt and 80 ml water with a stick blender for 2 minutes into a smooth, runny batter.
Leave the batter to rest for 20 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, add a small ladle of batter at a time and cook on one side only until the surface is full of small holes.
Segment the orange, drizzle the pancakes with honey and serve with the orange segments.

title: Ricotta Toast with Figs, Pistachios and Honey
instructions: Toast the bread until golden brown.
Stir the ricotta until creamy and spread thickly on the bread.
Slice the figs and lay them on top.
Sprinkle with chopped pistachios and drizzle with honey.

title: Middle Eastern Semolina Pudding with Dates and Pistachios
instructions: Heat the milk with the cinnamon and cardamom in a saucepan.
Sprinkle in the semolina while stirring and let it swell over low heat for 4–5 minutes.
Stone and chop the dates and stir in half of them.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the remaining dates and chopped pistachios.

title: Socca from Nice with Tomatoes and Olives
instructions: Stir the chickpea flour with 140 ml water, half of the oil and salt until smooth and leave to swell for 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 250°C (top heat) with the pan inside.
Coat the hot pan with the remaining oil, pour in a thin layer of batter and bake for 8–10 minutes until the edge darkens.
Halve the tomatoes and arrange them on the socca with the olives, rocket and rosemary.

title: Sicilian Pasta con le Sarde with Fennel and Pine Nuts
instructions: Chop the fennel, setting the fronds aside, and cook in salted water for 8 minutes. Keep the cooking water.
Sweat the onion in olive oil and add the tomato purée, raisins and pine nuts.
Cut the sardine fillets into pieces, fry them along for 3 minutes and add the fennel.
Cook the bucatini in the fennel water until al dente, drain and fold into the sauce with a little cooking water.
Sprinkle with the fennel fronds.

title: Ligurian Trofie with Pesto, Potatoes and Green Beans
instructions: Peel the potato and cut into small cubes; break the beans into 3 cm pieces.
Pre-cook the potatoes in salted water for 5 minutes, then add the pasta and, halfway through the cooking time, the beans.
Finish cooking everything together and drain, keeping 3 tbsp of the cooking water.
Stir the pesto with the cooking water and toss with the pasta and vegetables.
Sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Apulian Fave e Cicoria with Bread
instructions: Cook the broad beans with 80 ml water and the diced onion for 10 minutes until soft.
Process into a coarse purée with a masher or stick blender and season with salt.
Cut the chicory into strips, blanch in salted water for 4 minutes and drain.
Put the purée in a bowl, place the chicory alongside and drizzle with olive oil and lemon.
Serve with toasted bread.

title: Tuscan Roast Pork Fillet (Arista) with Rosemary Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional).
Rub the pork fillet with chopped rosemary, garlic, salt and pepper and sear all over in hot oil.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and the onions into eighths, mix with rosemary and roast in a dish in the oven for 35 minutes.
After 15 minutes, add the fillet to the potatoes and cook for about 18 minutes, then let it rest for 5 minutes.
Boil the beans in salted water for 6 minutes and serve everything with the meat sliced.

title: Sicilian Caponata with Toasted Bread
instructions: Dice the aubergine, salt it and leave for 10 minutes to draw out the water, then pat dry.
Fry the aubergine in olive oil for 8 minutes until golden brown and remove.
Sweat the onion and celery for 5 minutes and add the passata, olives, capers and raisins.
Return the aubergine to the pan, season sweet and sour with sugar, vinegar and salt and braise for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with pine nuts and serve with toasted bread.

title: Veal Saltimbocca alla Romana with Spinach
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cook in salted water for 15–18 minutes.
Pound the veal escalopes flat, top with a sage leaf and ham and secure with a toothpick.
Fry the escalopes in olive oil for 2 minutes per side, ham side first.
Wilt the spinach with garlic in a pan for 3 minutes and season with salt and nutmeg.
Arrange everything together.

title: Apulian Octopus Salad with Potatoes and Celery
instructions: Gently cook the octopus in boiling salted water with a bay leaf for 40–45 minutes until tender and let it cool in the cooking liquid.
Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes, peel and slice.
Cut the octopus into pieces, thinly slice the celery and halve the tomatoes.
Mix everything with olives, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and parsley.
Serve lukewarm or chilled.

title: Tuscan Panzanella with Cucumber and Basil
instructions: Cut the bread into 2 cm cubes and toast in the oven at 180°C for 8 minutes without fat.
Dice the tomatoes, peel the cucumber and cut into pieces, and slice the onion into thin rings.
Mix everything with capers, olive oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Fold in the bread cubes, leave to infuse for 10 minutes and sprinkle with basil.

title: Polenta with Mushroom Ragout and Parmesan
instructions: Bring 300 ml water to the boil with salt, sprinkle in the polenta and let it swell over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring.
Slice the mushrooms and fry in olive oil over high heat until they take on colour.
Add the onion, tomato purée and thyme and braise for 5 minutes with a splash of stock.
Stir half of the Parmesan into the polenta.
Arrange the polenta on a plate, top with the ragout and sprinkle with Parmesan.

title: Venetian Risi e Bisi with Peas
instructions: Finely dice the onion and sweat in olive oil until translucent.
Add the rice, sweat briefly and add half of the peas.
Gradually add hot stock and cook for about 15 minutes until the rice is soft and has a soupy consistency.
Add the remaining peas for the last 3 minutes, stir in the Parmesan and season with pepper.

title: Greek Briam with Courgette and Potatoes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C (fan).
Cut the potatoes, courgette and aubergine into thick slices and the onion into rings.
Mix the vegetables in a baking dish with the passata, olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper.
Cook in the oven for about 50 minutes, turning once, until the potatoes are soft.
Serve sprinkled with parsley.

title: Baked Spanakopita with Spinach and Feta
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C (conventional).
Fry the onion, add the spinach and let it wilt, then squeeze out and let it cool.
Mix the spinach with the feta, egg and dill.
Brush a small dish with oil, line with half of the filo pastry, add the filling and cover with the remaining pastry.
Brush the top thinly with oil and bake for 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Baked Sea Bream with Lemon Potatoes (Tsipoura)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C (conventional).
Cut the potatoes into wedges, put in a dish with onion rings, oil, lemon juice and oregano and pre-cook for 25 minutes.
Slice the tomatoes, add them to the potatoes and place the salted sea bream fillets on top.
Cook for another 12–15 minutes until the fish is done.
Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Gemista – Stuffed Tomatoes and Peppers with Herb Rice
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Cut the tops off the tomatoes and peppers and hollow them out, finely chopping the tomato flesh.
Fry the onion and mix with the rice, chopped tomato flesh, passata, pine nuts, raisins and herbs.
Fill the vegetables two-thirds full with the rice mixture, as the rice swells, and put the tops back on.
Place in a dish, drizzle with oil and pour in 100 ml water.
Bake for about 45 minutes until the rice is cooked and the skin is lightly browned.

title: Greek Avgolemono Soup with Rice and Chicken
instructions: Bring 400 ml stock to the boil, poach the chicken in it for 12 minutes, then remove and shred.
Cook the rice and diced carrot in the stock for 15 minutes until soft.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice until frothy and slowly stir in a ladle of hot stock so the egg doesn't curdle.
Stir the egg mixture back into the pot and do not let it boil again.
Add the chicken and serve with dill and pepper.

title: Turkish Tomato Bulgur Pilaf with Yoghurt
instructions: Dice the onion and pepper and sweat in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato purée and diced tomatoes and reduce for 5 minutes.
Stir in the bulgur, top up with stock, bring to the boil covered and leave to swell over the lowest heat for 10 minutes.
Remove from the heat, leave to rest for 5 minutes and fluff up with a fork.
Serve with a dollop of yoghurt.

title: Turkish Lahmacun with Minced Beef and Parsley Salad
instructions: Knead the flour with the yeast, salt and 45 ml lukewarm water into a dough and leave to rise for 30 minutes.
Knead the mince with finely diced tomato, pepper, onion, tomato purée, parsley, salt and paprika into a spreadable mixture.
Preheat the oven to 240°C. Roll the dough out into two very thin oval flatbreads.
Spread the mince mixture wafer-thin over the flatbreads and bake for 7–9 minutes.
Top with salad, parsley and lemon juice and roll up, or eat with the salad.

title: Baked Trout with Fennel, Tomatoes and Bulgur
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Cut the fennel into wedges and the onion into rings and bake in a dish with the cherry tomatoes, oil, salt and pepper for 18 minutes.
Leave the bulgur to swell in twice the amount of salted water for 10 minutes.
Salt the trout fillets, drizzle with lemon juice, lay on the vegetables and cook for 12 minutes until the fish is just cooked.
Serve on the bulgur with dill and lemon wedges.

title: Air Fryer Mücver – Turkish Courgette Fritters with Yoghurt Dip
instructions: Grate the courgette, salt it and leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze out firmly.
Stir with the egg, flour, crumbled feta, dill and spring onion into a mixture.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C, shape 8 small fritters, oil lightly and place in the basket.
Cook for 12–14 minutes, turning halfway, until golden brown.
Stir the yoghurt with dill, salt and lemon juice and serve alongside.

title: Kabak Tatlısı – Baked Pumpkin with Tahini and Walnuts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Cut the pumpkin into thick wedges, sprinkle with sugar and cover in a dish with 3 tbsp water.
Bake for 45 minutes until the pumpkin is soft and lightly caramelised.
Drizzle with tahini, sprinkle with chopped walnuts and cinnamon and serve lukewarm.

title: Lebanese Mujadara with Crispy Onions and Cucumber Yoghurt
instructions: Pre-cook the lentils in salted water for 12 minutes.
Slice the onions into thin rings and fry in rapeseed oil over medium heat for 20 minutes until brown and crisp.
Add the rice and cumin to the lentils, top up with a little water and leave to swell for 12 minutes.
Fold in half of the crispy onions.
Stir the yoghurt with grated cucumber and serve with the remaining crispy onions alongside the mujadara.

title: Baked Kibbeh with Lamb and Pine Nuts
instructions: Soak the bulgur in cold water for 15 minutes, drain and squeeze out.
Knead half of the lamb mince with the bulgur, half the onion, cinnamon, allspice and salt into a smooth paste.
Fry the remaining mince with the rest of the onion and add the pine nuts and parsley.
Press half of the bulgur paste into a small dish, spread the filling on top, cover with the remaining paste and brush with the oil.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes and serve with yoghurt and diced cucumber.

title: Lebanese Shish Taouk Skewers with Pepper and Rice
instructions: Stir the yoghurt with tomato purée, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt and half of the oil.
Marinate the diced chicken in it for at least 30 minutes; cut the pepper and onion into pieces.
Thread the chicken onto skewers, alternating with pepper and onion, and cook in a griddle pan for 12 minutes until golden brown all over.
Cook the rice in salted water according to the packet instructions and drain.
Arrange the skewers on the rice and sprinkle with pomegranate seeds and parsley.

title: Baba Ghanoush with Pitta and Pepper
instructions: Prick the aubergines several times and bake in the oven at 220°C for 30–35 minutes until the skin is black and the flesh collapses.
Scrape out the flesh and leave it to drain.
Roughly mash with tahini, yoghurt, lemon juice, garlic and salt.
Spread on a plate, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve with pitta and cucumber and pepper sticks.

title: Israeli Roast Cauliflower with Tahini and Pomegranate
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C.
Divide the cauliflower into large florets and toss with olive oil, salt and the chickpeas.
Roast in the oven for 30 minutes until the edges are brown.
Stir the tahini with lemon juice, garlic, salt and 3 tbsp water into a smooth sauce.
Arrange on a plate with the sauce, pomegranate seeds, pine nuts and parsley.

title: Dolma – Stuffed Vine Leaves with Mint and Lemon
instructions: Finely dice the onion and sweat in 1 tsp olive oil, then briefly toast the rice, pine nuts and currants with it.
Cook with 100 ml water, mint, salt and pepper for 8 minutes until half done, then let it cool.
Place a teaspoon of filling on each vine leaf, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Layer the rolls tightly in a pot, pour in the lemon juice and 150 ml water and weigh down with a plate.
Steam gently for 25 minutes, let it cool and serve with yoghurt.

title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine with Apricots and Almonds
instructions: Dice the lamb and sear all over in olive oil.
Add the onion, carrot and ras el hanout, top up with stock and braise, covered, for 45 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and apricots and cook for another 15 minutes.
Pour the same amount of hot water over the couscous, leave to swell for 5 minutes and fluff up with a fork.
Serve the tagine on the couscous, sprinkled with almonds.

title: Fish Tagine with Chermoula, Potatoes and Olives
ingredients: Chermoula (coriander, parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, lemon)
instructions: Make the chermoula from chopped herbs, garlic, spices, lemon juice and half of the oil.
Layer the potato slices and onion in a wide pot and pre-cook with 100 ml water for 15 minutes.
Add the pepper and tomatoes, brush the fish pieces with chermoula and lay them on top.
Add the olives and cook, covered, over medium heat for 12–15 minutes.
Serve with fresh coriander.

title: Moroccan Carrot Salad with Orange and Cinnamon
instructions: Finely grate the carrots.
Segment the orange, catching the juice.
Stir the orange juice with lemon juice, oil, cinnamon, cumin and salt to make the dressing.
Mix the carrots, orange segments, raisins and mint with the dressing.
Serve cold, sprinkled with toasted almonds.

title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Olives and Preserved Lemon
ingredients: Preserved lemon, turmeric, ginger, saffron, stock
instructions: Slice the onions into thin rings and soften in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Rub the chicken with turmeric, ginger, saffron, salt and pepper and add to the onions.
Pour in the stock and braise gently, covered, for 35 minutes.
Cut the preserved lemon into strips, add with the olives and cook for another 10 minutes.
Serve with flatbread for dipping.

title: Baked Tunisian Brik with Tuna and Egg
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Mix the tuna with finely chopped onion, capers, parsley, salt and pepper.
Lay two sheets of filo on top of each other, place the tuna mixture in the middle, make a well and carefully add the egg.
Fold the pastry into a triangle, brush thinly with oil and bake for 12–15 minutes until golden brown.
Serve with salad and tomato wedges.

title: Egyptian Koshari with Lentils, Rice and Tomato Sauce
instructions: Boil the lentils for 15 minutes; cook the rice and pasta separately and drain.
Fry the onion rings in rapeseed oil over medium heat for 15 minutes until crisp and brown.
Reduce the passata with garlic, cumin, vinegar and salt for 10 minutes.
Layer the rice, lentils, pasta and chickpeas, pour over the tomato sauce and scatter the crispy onions on top.

title: Egyptian Bamia – Okra Stew with Beef and Rice
instructions: Dice the beef and sear all over in olive oil.
Add the onion and garlic, top up with passata and 200 ml water and braise for 35 minutes.
Wash the okra, trim the stalk ends and add to the stew for 12 minutes.
Season with coriander, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Cook the basmati rice and serve together.

title: Spanish Seafood Paella
instructions: Fry the onion, pepper and tomato in olive oil in a large pan for 8 minutes.
Add the rice and toast briefly with the paprika and saffron.
Pour in the hot stock and cook for 12 minutes without stirring.
Scatter the squid, prawns, mussels and peas on top and cook for another 8 minutes until the liquid has been absorbed.
Leave to rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Catalan Escalivada with Sardines on Bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C, place the aubergine, pepper and unpeeled onion on a baking tray and brush with oil.
Roast for about 40 minutes, turning once, until the skins are dark and the vegetables are soft.
Leave the vegetables to cool in a covered bowl for 10 minutes, then peel and tear into strips.
Dress with sherry vinegar, garlic, salt and pepper.
Arrange on toasted bread and top with the sardines and parsley.

title: Moroccan Orange Salad with Dates and Pistachios
instructions: Peel the oranges generously, removing the white pith, and cut into thin slices.
Arrange in a circle on a plate.
Stone the dates, cut into strips and scatter over the oranges.
Drizzle with orange blossom water, sprinkle with chopped pistachios, cinnamon and mint and chill.

title: Ajo Blanco – Chilled Almond Soup with Grapes
instructions: Remove the crust from the bread and soak briefly in cold water.
